What is this?

Every YSWS asks you to ship a website.

Almost all of them are built on a laptop. For a laptop.

And phones? Nobody cares

Mobile Friendly is the YSWS where your phone is the main screen.

See how it works

How this works

Five steps.

  1. 11. Open your site on your phone. Your real phone, not a resized window. (It usually looks better anyway) Notice every pinch, zoom and sideways scroll.
  2. 22. Find what feels sloppy. Tiny text, buttons a thumb can’t hit, menus that only open on hover.
  3. 33. Fix the layout. Stack the columns, size buttons for thumbs, keep it readable at 360px wide.
  4. 44. Ship it. Ship it. A reviewer tries it one-handed on a real phone.
  5. 55. Get your phone stuff. Passed? Pick a case, a charger, a power bank or other accessories and we mail it to you.

Q&A

Hover a question for the answer. On a phone, tap it. :)

  • Teens 13 to 18, anywhere in the world. You need the Hack Club Slack to post in #mobile-friendly.

  • No. You can ship someone else’s site if they agree (a company, a friend, etc.), and of course you can ship your own too! The site must NOT be mobile-optimized before the YSWS starts (I know it’s sad, but it is what it is :( ). One bigger font size doesn’t count.

  • A reviewer opens it on a real phone, one hand, desktop mode off. 360px wide, no sideways scroll, no zooming to read.

  • Yes. HTML, Astro, React, Svelte, whatever. We only care how it feels on a phone.
